messages:
mohan: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — folks asked for clearer GA timing for Optimize 'suggestions' and the Console onramp. Short answers welcome, we need something we can pin to the roadmap board.

elaine: TL;DR: Hosted GA target mid-May. Dedicated will be preview in May and GA in June after the perf sweep. Private on-request starting June, then rolling to customers during June–July ops windows. I'll post dates + a migration checklist.

riley: Can we define the canary cohort knobs? e.g. percent, org filters, route-level pins — want to ensure engineers know how to configure safely.

elaine: Suggested canary config (adding this to Console templates):
```
canary:
  percent: 5
  filters:
    - org_tier: \"beta\"
    - route: \"^/v1/generate\"
  fallback: \"optimize-v1\"
```
We'll include this as an option in the new "canary wizard".

sam: For Dedicated clusters: what's the perf delta when "suggestions" is enabled? numbers we can cite to customers?

elaine: Current bench: median token latency +7–12ms at seq=512 when suggestions hook is enabled; p95 increases ~20–40ms under medium load (depends on batching). Cost delta ~ +3% compute on typical workloads. We'll publish the perf deck + microbench scripts next week.

anna: Migration question: customers on SDK v0.9 — do we auto-upgrade routes or require manual opt-in? Need explicit guidance for support.

riley: No automatic route upgrades. Plan is to expose a one-click "create migrated route" in Console that clones the route with the new Optimize config and pins the SDK version. Manual opt-in to be explicit. We'll add a migration script in devex repo too.

mohan: Good. Can we capture owners and dates so PMs and sales have something concrete?

elaine: Owners + commitments: @elaine (product) — publish GA timeline + migration checklist by 2025-05-05; @riley (devex) — add Console template + migrate UI by 2025-04-28; @sam (infra) — finalize perf tuning + publish benchmarks by 2025-05-02. I'll add these as roadmap tasks.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: console-template v3.2 -> 5% traffic (id: canary-2025-04-20-177162). Logs: https://deploys.internal/177162 

jen (ops): Heads-up: Private appliance upgrades require a maintenance window for the agent update. Ops can coordinate windows starting week of 2025-06-02.

mohan: Thanks — @elaine please drop the checklist into the roadmap doc and tag me when done. :thumbsup:

riley: ack, will post the Console template PR and link here when ready.

sam: adding perf scripts to infra/benchmarks now. will ping when published.

anna: will prepare a short customer-facing FAQ for support and sales once checklist is live.

mohan: perfect, closing loop — we'll surface these owners in the roadmap board and update SRE/Support playbooks.
